coordinates.scope: The catalogue publishes only the projected map position (x, y) derived from OSM-based coordinates. These OSM-derived map positions are made available under ODbL 1.0. This does not license photographs, logos or application code.

countyShapes.licenseStatus: No formal LICENSE file or named licence found. README says: Feel free to reuse.
countyShapes.upstreamNotice: Upstream README attributes council data to OpenStreetMap under ODbL and province data to Natural Earth. The precise licence chain for the regional file remains to be clarified; no MIT or CC0 licence is claimed.
countyShapes.changes: Source geometry was simplified upstream and converted into SVG paths for this app. Paths are available in catalog.json under regions.
